external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Cape Coast Technical University through the Office of International Programmes and Institutional Linkages participated in the International Week Tour and Tasting organised by Vives University in Bruges, Belgium from March 25, 2024, to March 29, 2024. The University was represented by Prof. Samuel B. Owusu-Mintah, Mr. Franklin DaCosta Dzormeku and Prof. Uriah Stonewell Tetteh.

external_collaboration.partner_name: Hochschule Dusseldorf – University of Applied Sciences
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Two (2) students from the Departments of Renewable Energy Technology and Mechanical Engineering were accepted to study at Hochschule Dusseldorf – University of Applied Sciences, Germany for the 2023/2024 academic year from March 1, 2024, to August 31, 2024, as exchange students in the Faculty of Mechanical Engineering and Process Engineering. This was under the “Erasmus+ Programme -Mobility with Partner Countries” (KA107) programme, funded by the European Commission.

external_collaboration.partner_name: Africa International Chamber of Commerce and Industry
external_collaboration.evidence_quote: The University signed an MoU with the Africa International Chamber of Commerce and Industry (AICCI) on Wednesday, September 18, 2024, with the primary aim to establish a framework for collaboration between AICCI and CCTU, to support educational endeavours, especially focusing on partnerships with key academic institutions in the European Union. Its special emphasis is on Estonia, facilitated through ACCI’s Estonia Chapter and its Baltic and Nordic Countries Secretariat.
